## Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is (e.g. *I'm always frustrated when...*).

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Native AOT & Zero-Reflection Compatibility
Describe how this feature adheres to Native AOT constraints (i.e. zero runtime reflection, static generic dispatch, Roslyn source generator support).

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, API design sketches, or code snippets about the feature request here.
